title: Convex sets with vanishing relative width and the reverse Cheeger inequality
summary: We study the reverse Cheeger inequality, which bounds from above the ratio of the first Dirichlet Laplacian eigenvalue to the square of the Cheeger constant. We first extend this inequality from convex sets to a broader class. We then analyze maximizing sequences among convex bodies. To quantify domain collapse, we introduce the notion of principal widths. For three-dimensional convex bodies, we prove that if the ratio of the first principal width to the second principal width vanishes along a sequence of convex bodies, then such sequence is maximizing.
